extraction.Name: John Sully
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612785 issued under the 'Declaration of Policy.' Application for patent in fee signed before John Knech, a notary public, on August 23, 1917. Letter written by Superintendent E. E. McKean dated February 6, 1929, referring to Circular 2464, letter of December 11, 1928, and Office letter of January 5, 1929. Superintendent inquired whether the Office desires information called for in Circular 2464 in this case.
